Indian Weddings

Every ceremony.
Every look.

Multi-day celebrations need a team that understands them. We plan each event as its own look, coordinate early-morning starts and quick changes, and scale the team for the whole family.

Multi-day celebrations are productions. Nikoleta leads as founder, lead artist and coordination specialist: look design, full glam timeline and communication with planners, stylists and vendors are part of every Indian bridal experience.

Up to two artists fully dedicated to the bride, from first look to last touch-up. Veil, jewellery, transitions between ceremonies, and calm when it gets intense.

Packages: The Heritage for traditional multi-day celebrations, The Modern Fusion for cross-cultural and destination weddings, and The Royal Bride Experience for complete peace of mind. Deposit €200 per event day.
